purpose: Teach: 口語/前衛/性欲/優勢/伯爵/健常/皇位/綱領

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の口語表現を、警察、分析されてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police are analyzing the suspect's speech patterns, aren't they?
lines.style: Curious, probing tone. Lean slightly forward. Genuine interest—not testing, genuinely wanting to understand the method. Steady pacing, thoughtful pauses between clauses.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、前衛的な犯罪手口にも対応します
lines.en: The police respond to even avant-garde criminal methods.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Professional authority without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. Slight pause before 'even'—acknowledging the uniqueness. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、性欲犯罪の心理プロファイルを、警察、作成されますね
lines.en: In this case, I imagine the police create a psychological profile of sex crimes, don't they?
lines.style: Tentative intellectual curiosity. Voice rises slightly at the question mark—genuinely asking, not performing knowledge. Slight hesitation before 'psychological'—choosing the right term carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、優勢な犯罪組織の動向を監視します
lines.en: The police monitor the movements of dominant criminal organizations.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, procedural. No inflection—just stating function. Brief, efficient phrasing. The tone of someone explaining routine work without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、伯爵家ゆかりの古美術盗難を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: In this case, the police handle the theft of antiquities connected to the earl's family, don't they?
lines.style: Careful, specific curiosity. Slight elongation on 'antiquities'—respecting the precision of the term. Gentle lift at the end. Wondering aloud, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、健常者と要支援者の境界事案にも対応します
lines.en: The police respond strictly to cases involving the boundary between able-bodied and support-needing individuals.
lines.style: Measured gravity. Emphasis on 'strictly'—this matters. Slower pace than before. Respectful tone, acknowledging complexity. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、皇位継承時の警備計画、警察、立てられますね
lines.en: In this case, the police prepare security plans for imperial succession, don't they?
lines.style: Hushed respect. Lower volume, slower pace. This is weighty—the speaker knows it. Careful enunciation. The tone of someone acknowledging something beyond routine.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、政党綱領違反の事案にも厳しく対応します
lines.en: The police respond strictly to cases involving violations of party platform principles.
lines.style: Firm resolve. The word 'strictly' carries weight and conviction. Slight forward lean. No ambiguity—this is where the line is drawn. Steady, uncompromising tone.
